question: Is this domain currently being advertised?
answer: Every instrument available returns nothing — and one of them, the Ads Transparency Center, is known to miss this exact attack class, because it held nothing for the Trezor campaign that demonstrably ran. So: no evidence of advertising, not a proven absence of it.
page_status: LIVE, verified by direct fetch 2026-08-09. Title: 'Leder Live | Ledger Live App Crypto Wallet - Official Site'. Solicits recovery phrase and private key.

tests.test: Ads Transparency Center, domain = ledgerstart-web.com, regions US / GB / DE
tests.control: PASSED in the same run - trezor.io US returned 40 creatives (Trezor Company s.r.o.)
tests.route: routed through a Frontier residential exit in Calimesa, California, because the datacenter IP was 429-ing
tests.weight: Weak. ATC also held zero records for the Trezor campaign that demonstrably ran.

tests.test: urlscan.io - every public capture of the URL
tests.result: 3 captures (2026-02-24, 2026-03-20, 2026-06-02). NONE carries a gclid, gad_source, gbraid or gad_campaignid
tests.control: n/a - the same query shape returned ad parameters for 16 other Google Sites URLs
tests.weight: Moderate. Where a page IS reached by ad click, scanners routinely capture the parameters.

tests.test: Live SERP, GB residential exit (Vodafone), query = the page's own exact title
tests.result: Page does not appear. Google autocorrects the 'Leder' misspelling to 'ledger' and returns normal results
tests.control: SERP rendered fully (painted, real organic results, AI Overview present)
tests.weight: Moderate for organic visibility, none for paid.

tests.test: Live SERP, US, query = 'ledger live download'
tests.result: NOT MEASURED - 6 of 6 residential exits received Google's /sorry/ interstitial
tests.weight: None. Reported as a gap, not as an absence.

conclusion: The page is live and malicious but shows no sign of active paid promotion or organic ranking. The most likely reading is a dormant or low-traffic asset in a portfolio - registered, built, and left standing. It cost the operator nothing to leave up.
